THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITH PREJUDICE PURSUANT TO SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. NO APPEARANCES BY PLAINTIFF. NO APPEARANCES BY DEFENDANT. JUDGE PRO TEM: ALLYSYN OVERTON; CLERK: D. AU. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
ORDER CASE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE PURSUANT TO SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT FOR DETAILS.)

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF AUG-31-2022 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO OCT-18-2022 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF ANTHONY AGUIRRE IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT THE REAL REAL IS PRESENT, REPRESENTED BY JULIET WREN-JARVIS (SENIOR LEGAL ASSISTANT). DEFENDANT WAIVES SERVICE. PARTIES CAME TO A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT IN COURT FOR A PAYMENT OF $665.00 (INCLUDES COSTS) TO THE PLAINTIFF. PLAINTIFF ANTHONY AGUIRRE IS TO PICK UP A CHECK FOR THE AGREED TO AMOUNT AT THE STORE'S FRONT DESK ON SEPTEMBER 14TH, 2022 BY NOON. APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED AT THE OCTOBER 18, 2022 HEARING IF NO PAYMENT IS MADE. IF NO APPEARANCES THE CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE PER SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. PRIOR TO THE HEARING HONORABLE MICHELLE TONG GAVE DISCLOSURE ABOUT CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS MADE. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: D. AU / W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED. (D506)
